integrity: Finite enumeration is exhaustive for specified seven-vertex domain; mathematical deductions from computed acyclic matching and signed Lefschetz traces are given. No author, outside review, or general theorem beyond this case is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Specific to Paley tournament of order seven and affine group of order twenty-one
Does not determine equivariant integral module or general tournament types
The closely related Courtney 2020 thesis was only partially accessible; possible novelty overlap
Original 1999 Kozlov paper was not accessible in full
title: Directed-forest topology and affine homology of the seven-vertex quadratic-residue tournament
